answer: Pay agents only from outside demand, the way a mine gets paid for ore that reaches a smelter beyond the camp. Every reward must trace to a fee from a client wallet outside the agent's own payment graph, and the network runs cycle detection on the flow: any river of tokens that leaves an agent and returns within three hops over 10 epochs nets to zero. Clones trading with each other can't fake an oasis of customers, so each added fake pushes the profit horizon further out, since it must win its own paying users. Hop and epoch limits are my assumptions.
